title: Specify and scaffold the Caravan Rust CLI
description: Encode the operator's agent-in-the-loop merge-queue design in SPEC.md, critically resolve or explicitly record key semantic gaps, then scaffold a Rust `cara` CLI using the established mcp-cli, updatable-cli, and feedback-cli ecosystem patterns plus a Nix flake and baseline CI/docs. The initial executable should expose agent-friendly help and structurally register the planned command surface without pretending unimplemented queue operations work. After landing the foundation, decompose the implementation into parallel, dependency-aware beads for crvn-dev-msm-0/1/2.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

title: Implement Caravan v1 agent-in-the-loop merge queue
description: Parent delivery epic for the SPEC.md v1 contract: GitHub discovery, graph validation, mechanical compatibility, membership mutations, navigation, sync/head advancement, CI and force-squash decisions, hooks/loop, MCP parity, and end-to-end verification. Work is intentionally split into dependency-aware lanes for crvn-dev-msm-0/1/2; this epic is coordination-only and must not be auto-claimed as an implementation bead.
creator: ms-mac:caravan:ms-mac-caravan-crvn-dev-msm-0

bead.title: Define Caravan domain model and strict repository config
bead.description: First parallel lane under bd-caab31. Implement the stable core types from SPEC.md (PR snapshot, checks/automerge state, caravan chain/fleet, graph/decision kinds, optimistic preconditions, operation/event IDs) plus strict `.caravan/config.yaml` loading/validation with version, force_merge, loop, and hook policy. Keep this lane pure and GitHub-I/O-free in new focused modules (primarily src/model.rs and src/config.rs); update AppContext to carry resolved config. Replace no command stubs except config-related plumbing. Add serde/schema/unit tests and preserve CLI/MCP DTO stability for the other lanes.

bead.title: Implement gh-backed repository and pull-request discovery
bead.description: First parallel lane under bd-caab31. Build a narrow command-runner seam around `git` and authenticated `gh`, then discover repository/default branch/current branch/current PR plus open and recently merged labelled PR snapshots needed to derive caravans and advance merged heads. Use typed JSON queries, preserve exact head/base SHAs and auto-merge/check metadata, reject fork-only predecessor branches, and make subprocess behavior hermetic-testable with a fake runner. Work in focused adapter/discovery modules; do not implement graph policy or mutations. Rebase onto the core model bead when it lands and map adapter DTOs into its canonical types.
